scripts.clean:svg: set -eu; for w in 100 200 300 400 500 600 700; do pnpm dlx @material-design-icons/scripts delete svg --symbols --in icons/$w; done
scripts.download:svg: set -eu; for w in 400; do for s in outlined rounded sharp; do mkdir -p icons/$w/$s && pnpm dlx @material-design-icons/scripts download svg --symbols --weight $w --size 24 --to icons/$w; done; done
